children: OFA Group's revenue fell 99.60% year over year, primarily as a major commercial design and fit-out project completed in the prior-year quarter; earnings worsened as a higher amortization charge and professional-services costs contributed to a larger loss.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net Loss attributable to common shareholders”.
: Current-quarter revenue came mainly from project management fees, an ongoing residential design-and-build project and, for the first time, QikBIM.
: Eight projects in progress at September 30 had a total contract amount of $592.8K; the company expects to recognize the remaining $544.7K during the year ending March 31, 2027.
: Six-month gross margin increased 3 percentage points to 35.19%, reflecting a higher proportion of project management and application revenue with limited subcontracting and material costs.
: Amortization of the platforms increased quarterly depreciation and amortization; QikBIM generated its first $103 of revenue in the six months.
